summary: Returns the elapsed time of an indexed channel's high-resolution timer. Bounds-checks the channel index a1 against the global channel count dword_8B8E48 (0x008B8E48): when a1 + 32 >= dword_8B8E48 + 32, i.e. a1 >= dword_8B8E48, the index is out of range and the function returns 0.0. Otherwise it computes the per-channel entry at &dword_8B6C28[19 * a1 + 608] (global 0x008B6C28, 19-DWORD stride per channel with a 608-DWORD base offset) and returns PerformanceCounterTimerWithScaling on that entry.

local_names.dword_8B8E48: channel count used for the bounds check (global 0x008B8E48)

PerformanceCounterTimerWithScaling on the computed entry (0x00556510): return the elapsed time in seconds from the channel's embedded high-resolution timer.
Return the timer result from the in-range path.
